Introduction
This procedure details the Equipment Inspection activities 
I1, which are performed 
month as indicated by the M1 in the title block.
Safety Precautions
Work permit must be issued,
Circuit breaker isolation and earthing is required,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Change remote/local control switch to local position.
Work permit must be issued,
Circuit breaker isolation and earthing is required,
Wear your safety helmet, shoes .... etc
Change remote/local control switch to local position.
Tools and Equipment
Multimeter, blower, gas detector, buzzer, screw driver and set of common
 keys.
Work to be carried out
Check supply voltage. "220
 vdc and 220/380 vac
Check SF6 pressure and air pressure manometers
Check for air and gas leaks.
Clean mechanism auxiliary switch by dry air (use blower).
Check the aux. switch functioning by its correct position through position
 indication and
Check mechanical position indicators and observe the three poles
Clean the local cabinet by dry air (use blower).
Check the heater of local cabinet
Retighten all connection terminals of remote, and local cabinet
Drain off moisture from the air reservoir
 tank by draining a small amount of
 compressed air
Check the earthed connections
Check the unusual noise in the GIS Compartment
